highlights: Ekso’s powered platforms include current clinical EksoNR and personal Indego Personal, the separately documented clinical Indego Therapy and historical EksoGT, eLEGS and load-support HULC. The dated Nomad study-sale/rollout account retains its limited scope. Platform, software and lifecycle names do not establish interchangeable hardware.

Wandercraft announced that its acquisition of Ekso Bionics was signed and closed on October 1, 2026. Continued support intent for EksoNR and Indego Personal alongside Atalante X and Eve does not merge model identities or prove current stock; the acquisition FAQ retains existing service terms and conditional payer coverage.

GaitCoach, VariableAssist, SmartAssist and EksoPulse supply clinician feedback, adaptive assistance or session information. They are software/features rather than extra complete robots. Clinical recovery, safety, reimbursement, lightest/only and market-leadership statements remain attributed supplier claims, not independently exclusive advantages or individual medical guidance.

Current EksoNR patient fitting limits are separate from device mass and cargo load; paired batteries and extra sets are not measured continuous-duty hours. Indego Personal page mass versus linked Personal safety RevA remains an unresolved source/revision difference, while Clinical safety specifications belong to Indego Therapy.

Current EVO text and DynaWear’s site identify the industrial EksoWorks transfer, including EVO and ZeroG. EVO and EksoVest are spring-assisted passive wearables; ZeroG is tool-support equipment. Their assistance loads are not powered gait-robot cargo ratings, and they are retained as separate industrial roles rather than invented powered robot models.

BalanceTutor is engineered by MediTouch; Ekso describes its U.S. sales-agent/distributor role. HandTutor, ArmTutor, LegTutor and 3DTutor biofeedback products are not thereby manufactured by Ekso or automatically additional powered robots. EksoCare, training and warranties are services; reimbursement figures are not retail purchase prices.
